content:
maya_cs: Alert: Crescent AI showing ~3x embedding spend since onboarding (spike started 2026-03-18). Need QBR cost triage.
ethan_csm: saw the spike on dashboards this AM. Embeddings are 90% of the increase. @priya_finops can you confirm patterns?
priya_finops: quick look: nightly full reindex job + a few large ad-hoc batch reruns. sample: 
```
customer: crescent-ai, model:text-embedding-3-small, embedding_units: 12k/day -> 36k/day, job: nightly-full-reindex @02:00 UTC
```
priya_finops: Likely they reverted to full reindex as a safety fallback after a flaky incremental pipeline.
nora_engineer: We recommended incremental during onboarding. Their infra pushed a temporary full-reindex script and never rolled it back. I messaged their engs earlier.
maya_cs: Immediate plan: 1) ask customer to pause nightly reindex, 2) enable temporary account-level embedding throttle, 3) prepare cost sims (no commit, 3mo, 12mo) and Dedicated recommendation for QBR. Owners?
ethan_csm: Ill message the customer and request pause now; will escalate after 2h if no reply.
billing-bot: Uploaded last30d CSV: https://redwood.prod/storage/csvs/1748102468-crescent-costs.csv :receipt:
priya_finops: Running sims now; will deliver conservative and optimistic scenarios by Fri EOD and include breakeven. Recommend throttle at 20k/day until stable.
nora_engineer: I'll draft a 1-page incremental reindex guide + snippet by tomorrow noon to share with their infra team.
maya_cs: QBR scheduled 2026-03-28 11:00 PT. I'll prepare slides: cost impact, sims, onboarding friction & action items, incremental guide appendix. Dry run tomorrow. :thumbsup:
